title: Europe’s Broad Earnings Recovery
text:
Europe’s Broad Earnings Recovery

Cedric Gemehl, August Gudmundsson

Gavekal Research | 6 Aug 2026

Investors who question the sustainability of the AI earnings boom, but who nevertheless want to retain some exposure to the growth of artificial intelligence, may want to look again at European equities. Today, Europe offers a powerful earnings-recovery story, with a significant AI element. But best of all, the continent’s earnings growth is diversified across a broad range of sectors, and therefore stands a good chance of surviving even if the AI boom turns to bust.At the end of July, consensus estimates were projecting 12-month forward earnings-per-share growth for the MSCI Europe index of 15.4% measured in euro terms. That compares with a -2% contraction in July 2025.
